concerns.text: FR-007 mandates 50 trajectories per prompt per condition; T006 generates 20, citing 'per plan.md'. The spec was never amended to authorize the reduction, so T006 silently weakens an FR and changes the statistical power of the diversity/quality tests. Either amend FR-007 or restore 50.

FR-006/SC-006 require teacher logits for EVERY unselected rationale; T004 writes one AVERAGED logits vector per prompt and its validation only checks one entry per prompt, so SC-006's per-rationale coverage cannot be verified. Also T004 writes to data/processed/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl while FR-006/SC-006 name data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl — the same path mismatch that may have caused the T022 rejection.

US-2 requires a full trajectory log with 'token-level probabilities for every step' written to outputs/trajectory_log.jsonl. T005 logs to data/results/training_run_<run_id>.jsonl with no token-level probability field and no outputs/trajectory_log.jsonl artifact — the required evidence artifact has no implementing task.

T005 requires logging entropy_per_token (FR-015) AND validating logs against training_output.schema.yaml, but that schema omits entropy_per_token while declaring additionalProperties: false — the two verification clauses in T005 are mutually unsatisfiable as written.

FR-010 defines Human-Evaluation-Proxy as mean ROUGE-L F1 against held-out rationales; T007 implements ROUGE-L, but the output contract/data model define the proxy as three 1-5 Likert rater scores with median. T007's ROUGE-L output has no contract, and the contradictory rater-score definition is never produced or reconciled.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-002 and Constitution VI
concerns.text: T003 implements plan's quality-score stratification of privileged-context sampling; FR-002 and Constitution VI specify uniform random sampling of exactly one rationale. The stratification is unauthorized by the spec and biases the 'randomly sampled' claim; either amend FR-002 or drop stratification.
Spec assumes 500 on-policy steps per prompt; T005 runs 200. The 2.5x reduction in training budget underlying the 5-hour feasibility claim is undocumented in the spec.
